work.description: Indult CLXXXIX grants the hebdomadaries of Aversa cathedral the violet cassock, stockings, collar and hat-tassel; intitulation, narrative, grant, decernentes and non obstantibus clauses and dating clause survive. Its provenance note1 is LF34815. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF34693–34693; the source dating clause at LF34772–34775 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima ianuarii millesimo octin- gentesimo quadragesimo tertio, pontificatus No- stri anno decimo secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
